blurb: The Oxbow RV Resort is located in Penticton, British Columbia which is renowned for its vibrant, active community offering family-oriented festivals and events throughout the year. Penticton has two lakes, Okanagan and Skaha; the Oxbow RV Resort is located right across from Skaha Lake.
